name: Love/Pain
source:
An ordinary office worker, ordinary problems, an ordinary journey home, ordinary cries for help...

The most ordinary day is turned upside down for our protagonist and changed his life forever.

Who is this familiar girl?
Will she be able to rekindle the embers of his once-burning soul?
Will the protagonist survive the most important night of his life?

[Translated from https://anivisual.net/stuff/33-1-0-2709]
translation:
一个普通的上班族，普通的问题，普通的回家路，普通的呼救声……

最平凡的一天对我们的主角来说发生了翻天覆地的变化，并永远改变了他的生活。

这个熟悉的女孩是谁？
她能否重新点燃他曾经燃烧的灵魂的余烬？
主角能度过他一生中最重要的一夜吗？

[翻译自https://anivisual.net/stuff/33-1-0-2709]
